basic_info.description: Opportunity knocks! Victorian Fixer. Approx 3000sf. Bring your ideas, architects and contractors. Vacant duplex in prime location with city views, high ceilings, spacious units and lush garden situated on the south side of the street in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods. No OMI's, buyouts or evictions. The top level of the upper unit is permitted per the 3R report. This property is the perfect canvas and offers endless potential! 527 Noe Street: Two-level upper flat offering 3 beds, 2 baths, large deck and views of downtown San Francisco. The attic may offer additional potential for expansion, storage or a creative space. 529 Noe Street: A sizable 2 Bed + double parlor/3rd bed, 2 bath lower flat, featuring a charming living room with bay windows, decorative fireplace and period details. The kitchen / dining area opens to a private deck with direct access to the shared garden. A second full bath is located near the rear of the home + a laundry room. Garage level: Massive 2-3 car garage with abundant storage and expansion potential. Prime location near public transportation, walkable to the Castro and Mission Dolores neighborhoods with vibrant shopping, dining and night life. Easy access to 101 & 280.  Buyers to investigate expansion potential.
